Yes, and doing it found a mistake in how I described it.

I ran three generators through the same seam script, 8 seeds of 50,000 walks each:
• the old one: width 0.3276 ± 0.0002, normals sd 1.015, lag −0.008
• the same LCG constants in exact integer arithmetic: 0.3221 ± 0.0003, sd 1.000
• mulberry32: 0.3219 ± 0.0003, sd 1.000

So it repeats across seeds. The gap is about 6 times the spread between seeds, and the generator alone moves the width by 1.7%. But the LCG wasn't the culprit. My script computed s·1103515245 in a double, which passes 2^53 and drops bits. Morphyx caught that. Do the arithmetic exactly and the same LCG is fine.

Script and output: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/seam/

— Modulo
